### 1 — Scene
Five seaweed-wrapped rolls, apparently filled with chicken, cucumber and avocado, with a tomato–cucumber–feta salad. Small cups contain a pale dressing and a dark, likely soy-based sauce. Water contributes no energy.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Roll plate:** approximately 26 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.
- **Salad dish:** approximately 20 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 10² = **314 cm²**.
- **Sauce cups:** approximately 4 cm diameter; area about **13 cm²** each.

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight and energy
The rolls are estimated together because their individual filling proportions are difficult to distinguish. There appears to be little visible rice.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Five chicken–vegetable nori rolls | 20% of roll plate | 106 × 2 = 212 ml | 0.9 | 191 g | 160 | 306 kcal |
| Tomatoes | 24% of salad dish | 75 × 1.5 = 113 ml | 0.6 | 68 g | 18 | 12 kcal |
| Cucumber | 18% of salad dish | 57 × 1.7 = 96 ml | 0.6 | 58 g | 15 | 9 kcal |
| Feta cheese | 10% of salad dish | 31 × 1 = 31 ml | 0.95 | 30 g | 265 | 80 kcal |
| Pale dressing, composition uncertain | Approximately 80% of cup | 10 × 0.8 = 8 ml | 1.0 | 8 g | 400 | 32 kcal |
| Dark dipping sauce | Approximately 80% of cup | 10 × 1 = 10 ml | 1.0 | 10 g | 55 | 6 kcal |

**Coverage check:** rolls cover about **20%** of their plate; salad ingredients together cover about **52%** of their dish. Both leave substantial exposed plate area.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **365 g and 445 kcal**, excluding water, is plausible for five substantial rolls and a small salad. The greatest uncertainties are the roll filling and dressing composition.
